lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill region, with approximately 4-6 spots per column in the mid-lateral zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the columns of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like structure across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges are visible across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple smaller fish (likely remoras) are visible in the low-luminance region beneath the pectoral fin; strong caustic patterns from surface light refraction are overlaid on the anterior-dorsal flank.
